column1: # NOT A DECLARED FAMILY. Evidence for the named render-pass registry at 02CBF998.
# Each row: a 12-byte teardown `lea rcx,[node] ; jmp 005DDD60`, the registry node it
# unlinks, and the name that node is registered under - recovered from the
# REGISTRATION SITE, because the nodes sit past the raw end of .data and their
# name field is written at run time, not stored in the image.
# register 005FDCB0: 0 ok, 0x11 null name, 0x12 duplicate name. node: +0 name, +8 next.
